policy.rule: An issue closes only with explicit owner, exit criteria, owned regression evidence and target-runtime evidence where applicable.

issues.title: Vehicle/charger picker runtime qualification
exit_criteria: vehicle and charger open/edit/save works on target HA
canonical readback matches selection
refresh/reload/restart preserve persisted state
failed write remains visible and editor does not falsely commit

issues.title: V2 interface migration
exit_criteria: new UX paths are V2-first
remaining V1 dependencies are compatibility-only and enumerated
no V1-only primary authority in docs/code
affected paths have target V2 runtime proof

issues.title: Semantic versus HA transport value
exit_criteria: semantic IDs remain canonical truth
select transport uses exact published HA option
target vehicle and charger profile saves succeed without invalid-option error
canonical semantic readback proven

issues.title: Canonical visual rendering and blank/wrong imagery
exit_criteria: known vehicles never show another real model
known visual key never renders blank when package asset exists
neutral fallback is used for unresolved identity
picker/card/detail agree after refresh

issues.title: Charger component placement
exit_criteria: valid charger properties no longer fall into Engineering/Unmapped on target runtime
placement contract regression test exists

issues.title: Charger command materialization
exit_criteria: Restart/Identify/Unlock appear when backend publishes them
command readiness and invoke come only from Mobility command contract
target runtime proof exists

issues.title: Requested versus actual cross-screen parity
exit_criteria: requested intent never replaces actual readback
connected charger charger.power_kw remains actual power authority
overview/detail parity proven on target runtime

issues.title: Cross-screen runtime parity
exit_criteria: immutable candidate installed on target HA
Overview/Vehicles/Chargers/detail routes exercised
refresh/navigation/browser reload preserved
rollback proven

issues.title: Behavior-test hardening for high-risk runtime paths
exit_criteria: critical picker V2 write/readback behavior is executable-tested
visual selection behavior is executable-tested
source-string assertions remain only for literal owned declarations
no duplicate invariant ownership introduced

issues.title: Premium visual system and charger artwork provenance
exit_criteria: premium visual master/context policy documented
charger source/licence/provenance tracked
cards/pickers/detail/hero share one visual family per product
runtime-generated canonical identity imagery remains forbidden
